summary: Iter 59 — Full regression + 2 new features tested. 14/14 backend pytest cases PASS. All frontend flows verified: dashboard WladHubCard (split sub-components), my-path videos tab, Challenge30 week tabs/day cards (helper-function refactor), /payment-success (no 500 with fake session_id), all 5 quick-login buttons. New features (Group Coaching Monthly/Annual checkout + /cron/monthly-scorecard) fully working including idempotency.

backend_test_results.checkout_group_coaching_monthly: PASS (returns Stripe URL + session_id for accelerator user)
backend_test_results.cron_monthly_scorecard_idempotent: PASS (first call sent>=2 for 2 accelerator users, second call sent=0 via email_log dedup, month key correct)

frontend_test_results.quick_login_all_5_buttons: PASS — testids: quick-login-free/starter/standard/accelerator/raten (NOTE: 5th is quick-login-raten, NOT accelerator-raten)
frontend_test_results.dashboard_wladhub_starter: PASS — WladHubCard renders, score text present
frontend_test_results.dashboard_wladhub_accelerator: PASS — 3 score labels (KI-Kompetenz, Rhetorik, EQ) all visible

critical_code_review_comments: payments.py get_packages() returns tier_cfg from TIER_CONFIG['free'] when pkg tier is None (group coaching add-ons) — features dict shown is 'free' features which is misleading for add-ons. Consider returning empty features or an add-on-specific feature list.
admin.py /overview makes 11+ sequential DB queries via helpers. For a 100M-ARR dashboard, consider running them in asyncio.gather() for faster response.

cron_monthly_scorecard: if send_email fails (r.sent=False) it still inserts into email_log + scorecard_history, which means retries are blocked until next month. Consider only logging + snapshotting on success.

Quick-login 5th button testid is 'quick-login-raten' but credentials doc refers to 'accelerator-raten@wladbot.test' — for consistency prefer 'quick-login-accelerator-raten' (or document the naming explicitly).
test_credentials.md smoke-test script still uses 'access_token' key (actual API returns 'token') — unchanged doc typo from iter 58.
test_credentials: 5 seeded accounts (free/starter/standard/accelerator/accelerator-raten@wladbot.test) + test@test.com admin — all test123 password. Tokens retrieved via POST /api/auth/login (returns {token, user}).
seed_data_creation: cron_monthly_scorecard inserted entries into email_log + scorecard_history for the 2 accelerator users for the current month (2026-01). This means running the monthly cron again this month will return sent=0 — this is the correct idempotent behavior. To re-test, delete email_log entries with type='monthly_scorecard_2026-01'. Also, 2 stripe checkout 'initiated' rows created for accelerator@ user in payment_transactions (group_coaching_monthly + group_coaching_annual) — benign, no payment taken.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 iter-59 changes verified working: (1) admin_overview helper-refactor returns same shape, (2) wladhub 3layer returns ki_kompetenz/boardroom_rhetorik/strategisches_eq + overall_score + strengths + improvements, (3) my-path/videos returns dict (starter_videos + accelerator_videos arrays + unlocked_count), (4) Group Coaching add-on packages work (monthly €49, annual €299) — both create Stripe checkout, (5) /api/cron/monthly-scorecard is public+idempotent, scans accelerator users and dedups via email_log by month key. Quick-login 5th button testid is quick-login-raten. GroupCoachingUpsell only renders on status==='success' in PaymentSuccessPage.js — fake session_id keeps it in 'checking' state which is per spec. Challenge30 week-tab/day-card helpers (getWeekTabClass/getDayCardClass/getDayBadgeClass/renderDayIcon/getCtaLabel) all render correctly.
